about: Second Esdras (Ezra) tells how God's people came home from far away to rebuild God's house and learn God's law again.

pages.title: Going Home
pages.scene: God's people walking home to Jerusalem
pages.text: God's people had been taken far away to Babylon. Then King Cyrus said, "You may go home and build God's house again!" Thousands of people packed up and walked back to Jerusalem. They were so happy to be home.

pages.title: Ezra the Teacher
pages.scene: Ezra reading God's law to the people
pages.text: Ezra loved God's law. He studied it, he obeyed it, and he taught it to others. He led more people home to Jerusalem. He prayed for God to keep them safe on the long trip, and God did.
pages.lesson: Learn God's word, obey it and share it.
